posts.title: macOS App Store, Apple Pay and the missing buttons
posts.description: For the past few weeks i’ve been frustrated by a minor issue I couldn’t track down. If I attempted to purchase an app on the Apple App Store, or buy anything via Apple Pay in Safari, I ended up with a box to pay that had no buttons to actually continue. At first I thought it was another glorious Apple failure in macOS, but instead its me who is causing the issue.
